Realistic Job Overview
This is a customer support role serving sports card and collectibles customers who purchase products from Fanatics Collectibles and Topps. Representatives act as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries regarding orders, products, promotions, releases, policies, and account issues.
This is a multi-channel support position where representatives assist customers through phone, email, and web messaging. The role requires strong customer service skills, problem-solving abilities, and the ability to build relationships with repeat collectors. While not a sales role, representatives are expected to create positive customer experiences and maintain strong customer satisfaction scores.
The environment is likely moderate-to-high volume, especially during major product launches, card releases, and promotional events. Candidates who have a genuine interest in sports, trading cards, collectibles, gaming, or hobby communities will likely be more successful and engaged.

notes: Fanatics Collectibles is a new model and vision for the hobby, fundamentally changing the experience for current and future collectors, leagues, and players across many U.S. and international professional and college sports. The organization has long-term, exclusive rights to design, manufacture and distribute trading cards for several sports and entertainment properties, including MLB, MLBPA, the Premier League, MLS, UFC, Formula 1 as well as Disney, Marvel, Pixar, and Star Wars, among others. In January 2022, Fanatics Collectibles announced the acquisition of Topps, establishing the preeminent licensed trading card brand as the cornerstone of Fanatics’ trading cards and collectibles business, and jumpstarted its MLB and MLBPA rights to design, manufacture and distribute trading card
other: This is a quality remote customer service opportunity paying above the typical entry-level call center wage. The strongest candidates will have previous customer service experience and be comfortable working through phone, email, and web messaging simultaneously. Knowledge of sports, trading cards, collectibles, gaming, or hobby communities is a significant advantage because many customers are repeat collectors who are passionate about the products.
